variableDeclarations.name: current_playbook
variableDeclarations.description: Playbook the agent currently has open.

variableDeclarations.name: current_task
variableDeclarations.description: Task the agent currently has loaded inside the open playbook.

variableDeclarations.name: next_agent_actions
variableDeclarations.description: Reply and actions queued by a tool through set_next_agent_actions, played by the before-model callback without calling the model.

variableDeclarations.name: played_greeting
variableDeclarations.description: Whether the greeting was already sent.

variableDeclarations.name: pending_handoff_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason code set by a tool when the conversation must be handed off to a live representative.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_summary
variableDeclarations.description: Summary of the conversation for the representative, set by execute_live_agent_handover.

variableDeclarations.name: order
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by lookup_order: the order the customer is asking about (number, status, item, delivery) and its on-file shipping ZIP code, which is never shown to the model.

variableDeclarations.name: zip_check
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by verify_order_zip: the order number whose shipping ZIP code the customer verified, and failed ZIP attempts in the conversation.

variableDeclarations.name: sms_disclosure_played
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by play_sms_legal_disclosure: the order number the text message terms were shared for.

variableDeclarations.name: sms_summary_sent
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by send_sms_summary: the order number whose summary was texted.

variableDeclarations.name: canceled_order_id
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by submit_cancellation: the order number canceled in this conversation.

variableDeclarations.name: mail_return_order_id
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by create_mail_return: the order number a mail return was started for.

variableDeclarations.name: availability_order_id
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by check_return_pickup_availability: the order number pickup availability was checked for.

variableDeclarations.name: return_details
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by update_return_details: the courier pickup details collected for one order, and whether the customer confirmed the summary.

variableDeclarations.name: return_pickup
variableDeclarations.description: Written only by submit_return_pickup: the booked courier pickup (order number, confirmation ID, day and window).
